personalization.confirmOff: Switch off personalised Discovery? The likes and comments stored for it are deleted.
personalization.explanation: Off unless you switch it on. If you do, Klar stores which posts and comments you like, unlike or comment on, so Discovery can later show you posts that fit. Nothing you only look at is stored, and your home feed stays chronological. Entries are deleted once they are 12 months old (a month at a time), and all of them as soon as you switch this off again. <link>Privacy policy</link>

guidance.self_harm: If someone may be in danger right now, call 112. The TelefonSeelsorge is there around the clock, free and anonymous — for them and for you: 0800 111 0 111, 0800 111 0 222 or 116 123, and by chat at telefonseelsorge.de.
guidance.csam: Please don’t download, screenshot or forward it — not even to report it: that can be a crime in itself, and our team sees the original. You can also report it to <link>jugendschutz.net</link> or the police.
guidance.ncii: If the images show you: you don’t need to send us a copy. HateAid helps for free (<link>hateaid.org</link>), and you can report it to the police.
guidance.terrorism: If someone is in immediate danger, call the police on 110.
guidance.harassment: Blocking the person stops them from following, messaging or interacting with you — you can do that after reporting.

moderation.pointsExplained: Each confirmed violation adds points by how serious it was; they expire after a while. Warnings and suspensions are always decided by a person, never automatically.

guide.welcome1: Your home feed shows posts from the people you follow, newest first. Nothing is sorted by likes, and there are no ads.
guide.welcome2: Here's a quick look around. It takes a minute.
guide.find1: Tap at the top to look people up by username or name, then press Follow on their profile.
guide.find2: Private accounts approve each follower first. Until they do, the button says Requested.
guide.find3: <discovery></discovery> opens Discovery, the newest public posts from everyone. It's a good place to find people to follow.
guide.share1: Tap <newPost></newPost> to share photos with a caption. Anyone can see the posts of a public account; only followers see those of a private one.
guide.share2: Open a post to like and comment. <bell></bell> shows who followed you, liked or commented, and lets you accept or decline follow requests.
guide.shareUnverified: Posting, commenting and messaging start once you've clicked the link in the email we sent you.
guide.chats1: You can chat with people who follow you back. Open <chats></chats> and start a new chat with one of them.
guide.chats2: Reply to a message, react to it with an emoji, or edit and delete your own.
guide.chats3: Chats aren't end-to-end encrypted, so don't share anything there that must stay strictly secret.
guide.safe1: Report a post or profile with , and a comment with the Report link under it. We review every report and let you know the outcome.
guide.safe2: Press Block on a profile, and neither of you can follow, message, like or comment on the other any more. You can undo it in Settings → Blocked accounts.
guide.choices1: Klar is still in a test phase, so one choice comes first:
guide.choices2: You can change it later in <settings></settings>, where you can also make your account private, download your data, and turn on personalised Discovery, which stays off unless you choose it.
guide.choices3: Found a bug or have an idea? Use Feedback at the bottom of the page. This guide is there too.
